root_cause_categories.root_cause: LLM temperature and sampling produce different code paths for the same prompt across runs. Even with FORBIDDEN constraints, the LLM can generate hallucinated namespaces that survive beyond the constraint window in multi-step reasoning.
root_cause_categories.structural_weakness: max_repairs=1 in code_generator.py — single repair attempt is insufficient for persistent hallucinations. No escalation to a different few-shot template or different LLM temperature on persistent failure.

root_cause_categories.root_cause: Validation has 3 levels (compile, runtime, reviewer) but none provide semantic feedback that can guide LLM repair. The compiler says what is syntactically wrong. The runtime says what throws an exception. The reviewer says PASS/FAIL. None say 'your output content is incorrect in this specific way' — which is what the LLM needs to self-correct.
root_cause_categories.structural_weakness: reviewer feedback is binary (PASS/FAIL) and does not trigger LLM repair. Semantic output validation (does the output PDF actually have the merged content?) is not implemented — only file existence is checked for most types.
